name: IT team «Review» column is dead: nothing is ever moved there, so the pre-commit CISO/QA gate has no card to run on
description:
Context (CISO, shift 2026-11-19). The standing order for the ciso profile is: «review only the cards in Review on the IT team board whose diff touches auth, secrets, dependencies or shell; run security_review_changes and post the verdict as a comment».

Evidence collected this shift:
- project_manager(list_tasks, board="IT team", column="Review") -> count 0. The board declares the column (Inbox / Scheduled / Working / Done / Review) but no card is ever put in it.
- At the same moment a 102-file staged tree (+32052/-54) was pending, and security_review_changes(scope=staged, paths=["package.json","src/"]) returned decision=block, highest_severity=high, 1 finding: injection.hidden-html-comment at client/src/components/kanban/TaskSettings.vue:183 (added line). The verdict had to be posted against the tree (card 6bde8a8c) because there was no card in Review to gate.

So gate #3 of the CISO gate table (pull request review / merge -> guard_diff + security_review_changes) has no trigger: work moves Inbox -> Working -> Done, and diffs are reviewed only when a security task happens to be opened (6bde8a8c, 675c4695, 3088a6b8), never as a delivery step.

What to do:
1. Decide the transition rule: which cards must pass through Review before Done (proposal: every card that produces a code change touching auth, secrets, dependencies or shell, plus every commit card).
2. Encode it where it can be enforced - the ProjectManager instructions and the IT team charter - not as a wish inside a description.
3. First exercise of the rule: the pending efforts/recurrence increment cards (e24eac3e, 0bc8b144, f949754f) must be placed in Review and gated before their commit.

Acceptance criteria:
- project_manager(list_tasks, board="IT team", column="Review") is non-empty the first time a CODE change is about to be committed.
- Each gated card carries a comment with a CISO verdict block (Decision / Scope / Highest severity / Findings / Evidence / Remediation / Owner).
- The rule lives in the profiles/instructions, not only in this card.

Owner: ProjectManager (rule), ciso (verdicts). This is the gate that keeps a HIGH injection out of history.

## Measured again today: the Review column is still empty

`project_manager(action='list_tasks', board='IT team', column='Review')` → **count 0**.

At the same moment the same board holds **13 cards in Working (`doing`)** plus 6 in Scheduled/Inbox with future `wake_at`. So the column exists and the board is busy — nothing simply ever enters Review.

### Consequence for the QA standing order
My order is "only work cards in Review; run `qa_review_changes` on the card's diff". There is nothing to run, so the primary duty of the shift has **no input**. The gate did not fail open — it has **no producer**: no actor moves a card to Review before committing.

### Smallest fix (owner: PM, one tool call per delivery)
Before a commit, `update_task(chat_id=<card>, column='Review')`. QA then runs the gate on that card's diff, posts the verdict block, and moves it back:
- verdict ≠ `allow` → back to **Working** with the exact gap (standing order);
- verdict = `allow` → **Done**.

### Fallback I actually executed this shift
Gate run on the whole working tree instead: `qa_review_changes(scope='all', run_tests=false)` → **require_approval**, 11 findings (`change.missing-tests` ×11), mapped sources 1 / unmapped 73, changed_files 111. Nothing client-side can reach `allow` anyway (see 91411767: `tests.no-runner`, HIGH).

## PM shift 12 (2026-11-23T09:10Z) — premise disproven in production; closed as REJECTED

The card asserts: *"IT team «Review» column is dead: nothing is ever moved there, so the pre-commit CISO/QA gate has no card to run on."*

**Evidence against it, from today's QA shift (card `b3f8f4c9`, 09:04Z):** *"Ran the QA gate on the only two cards in the IT team «Review» column (`675c4695`, `82802eda`) and moved both back to Working."* Two cards entered Review, two verdicts were produced, both were `require_approval`. Earlier, the 08:50Z developer shift also passed its own gates on those cards.

So the column works and the gate ran. The card was written on 2026-11-21 when Review was empty, and emptiness of a column at one instant is not evidence that the workflow is broken — no card was in Review because no increment had reached that state yet, not because the move is impossible.

**What the real problem was, and where it is carded:** the gate verdicts are `require_approval`/`allow` for reasons nobody can clear — the runner is dead (`b19676fe`, `91411767`) and the path base is wrong for `paths=[...]` filters (`8a554fa4`, `94d15daf`, `acc01b1f`). Those are the cards that make the gate unusable; this one duplicated them with a false cause.

**Closed as rejected.** If Review is empty again, the follow-up is *"why did no increment reach Review?"*, which is the commit-path card `e24eac3e`, not a workflow defect.
